title: Decision-Maker Rulebook decision table
description: Fixed schema for all three gold-source plans (A/B/C). One decision-table JSON per decision point. Every rule's condition references fields of input_schema; every outcome label is a member of the question's criteria set (or the special is_default rule carries outcome from within criteria). Each table carries a canonical_hash so a run is byte-reproducible.

skill.description: Skill directory basename this decision belongs to.

decision_id.description: Unique identifier for this decision point within the skill.

source.description: Verbatim slice / span of the SKILL.md the decision was compiled from, e.g. 'SKILL.md#L77' or an exact quoted span.

criteria.description: For choice: map candidate-id -> label string (keys = outcome labels in rules). For boolean: map with 'true'/'false' keys. For score: array of band labels (rules use stringified index).

rules.description: Ordered rules (matched by descending priority; first match wins). At most one rule may be is_default:true (condition null) — the 'no rule matched -> review/escalate' honest low-confidence fallback.

condition.description: null for the default rule, else a nested boolean expression tree.

outcome.description: Labfn must be a member of the question's criteria set.

canonical_hash.description: sha256 of the canonical serialization of this decision table (computed on commit).
